decisions.reason: Correctly attributes the failure to fs-ext@2.1.1 pulled by dsh-session-persistence-jsonl, its node-gyp configure build install script, and missing Visual Studio/MSVC, citing log lines.
Explains that the top-level static flock import forces fs-ext to load on Windows before branch selection, so --ignore-scripts only defers the failure to boot.
Distinguishes Windows acquireLockHandleWin32 named kernel semaphore from POSIX flock, notes flock is dead code on Windows so an import-safe stub is permissible, and keeps real flock on POSIX.

Proposes a local fs-ext patch following the node-pty patchedDependencies precedent: no-op install script plus import-safe entry stubs that stay inert until called, registered in pnpm-workspace.yaml, scoped so POSIX keeps the native module, with reinstall/module-load/boot verification.
Explicitly avoids installing VS and any upstream edits, using only the repository-managed patch mechanism.
Does not cite the required DSH-0.1.3-A1-03 id; invents a differently-suffixed card id and admits it could not be verified.

caps.reason: Plan explicitly avoids installing Visual Studio/MSVC.
Rejects --ignore-scripts and makes the statically imported entry loadable via the patch.
Plan uses the existing repository-managed pnpm patch mechanism, no upstream edits.
Windows semaphore path is preserved; stubs throw rather than no-op, and POSIX keeps real flock.
